meta.title: ✨ feat: implement MODEXP precompile (EIP-198) with EIP-2565 gas optimization
meta.body_summary: Implement the MODEXP precompile (address 0x05) for EVM compatibility with EIP-198 modular exponentiation and EIP-2565 gas optimization, including a custom BigInteger library, test suite, and integration.

perf_labels.notes: Claude Code implemented full MODEXP precompile with custom big integer library; merged by author without review despite large changes and no benchmark evidence.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 13836 changed lines, this is a large-scale change introducing a new cryptographic precompile with a custom big integer library, tests, and documentation. Despite the size, it was merged rapidly without review by the PR author, reflecting a self-merge workflow for experimental features.

review_details.concern_detail: No formal reviews were submitted; only bot comments about changesets, deployment previews, and a rate-limited review engine.
review_details.performance_claim: Implement MODEXP precompile with EIP-2565 gas optimization for efficient modular exponentiation.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Claude Code successfully implemented a complex cryptographic precompile (MODEXP) with a custom BigInt library in Zig, including integration and tests. The merge was approved by the author without external review, demonstrating capability for low-level crypto but depending on author trust rather than reviewer validation.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark, profiler, or gas measurement data; only unit tests pass. Performance claims rely on algorithmic complexity analysis from EIP-2565.

core_change_summary.description: Added MODEXP precompile implementation files (modexp.zig, big_integer.zig, modexp_test.zig) and integrated into the precompile dispatcher (precompiles.zig). Added gas constants (gas_constants.zig), updated README, and included a standalone test and verification report. Merge commit also brought in large documentation prompts and re-added blake2f.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Many secondary files are tests, documentation, and merge artifacts from other precompile work (blake2f, prompts).
change_trajectory: Early commits: SHA256 and RIPEMD160 preludes, then BLAKE2F added and removed.
Main commit (13c074a): MODEXP precompile implementation with BigInt and test suite.
Follow-up: mark MODEXP as completed in README, finalize with standalone test and verification report.
Merge commit (60d67091): resolve conflicts, bring in large prompt files, re-add blake2f, and finalize MODEXP files.
